title: GTA 6 vs GTA 5: You Waited 4,811 Days
caption:
GTA 5 came out on 17 September 2013. GTA 6 launches today, 19 November 2026: 4,811 days later (our count). In that time GTA 5 sold-in more than 230 million copies (Take-Two).
Was GTA 6 worth the 13-year wait?

Sources: Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive (via Outlook Respawn)
ig_first_line: 4,811 days. That's how long you waited between GTA 5 and GTA 6.
